data.one_liner: Testing library for apps built with the Elementary architecture.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools and the testWidgetModel function to easily test WidgetModels and manage their lifecycle phases when using the Elementary architecture package.
use_when: You are building Flutter applications using the elementary architecture package
You need to test WidgetModels and manage their lifecycle events in tests
avoid_when: You are not using the elementary architecture package
You are looking for a general-purpose widget testing or BLoC testing library
strengths: Provides lifecycle manipulation tools like tester.init() and tester.didChangeDependencies()
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the elementary ecosystem
Limited utility outside of the Elementary architecture
